pages.text: Learn the native Eldritch knowledge from an Eldritch Manuscript.

pages.title: Some Pages Bite
pages.text: Mark an earned knowledge unlock without handing out its rare source.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the installed JEI recipe for the Eldritch Manuscript, then complete its native learning action. Credit follows the owning system’s knowledge change; a failed right-click does not count.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Native manuscript use unlocks Eldritch knowledge; carrying a scroll does not.
